summary: Tested confirmar-dados.html for the 'Local de Prova' fix in both single-inscription and two-inscription scenarios by seeding sessionStorage via Playwright add_init_script. Fix works correctly in both cases.
critical_code_review_comments: confirmar-dados.html is very large (~600 lines) with heavy inline styles and multiple <script> blocks that read the same sessionStorage key ('inscricaoDados'). Consider consolidating the three inline scripts and extracting styles for maintainability.
The final injection script relies on regex matching of 'Cargo:' text in cells; brittle if labels change. Add a stable data-* hook (e.g., data-role='cargo-row') for future changes.
seed_data_creation: Used Playwright add_init_script with sessionStorage.setItem('inscricaoDados', <json>) as instructed. Two payloads exercised: single inscription and segundaInscricao='Sim'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Confirmed via rendered innerText and row-index probe that: (1) single-inscription case renders 'Local de Prova: MARINGA' immediately after 'Função: ...' row (indices 16 → 17). (2) two-inscription case renders 'Local de Prova' immediately after 'Função (2ª):' row (indices 21 → 22). All regression rows also present: '1ª Inscrição' header, 'Núcleo Regional de Educação', 'Município(s)', 'Prova', 'Função', and 2ª block with CAMPO MOURAO/CAMPINA DA LAGOA/Controle e Processos Industriais/CI - Eletromecânica. Submit button label 'Confirmar inscrição' is present in HTML (input value=... at line 263) — note that document.body.innerText does NOT include <input value=...> so any next test should check button.value or getAttribute('value') instead of innerText.
rca of the issue: Original bug: Local de Prova was not shown. Fix in inline <script> at end of confirmar-dados.html inserts a new row via mkRow('Local de Prova', d.localProva || d.cidadeProva). Placement is conditional on segundaInscricao: inserted after cargoRow.nextSibling (post-Função) for single-inscription, and pushed after the 2ª block via insAfter for two-inscription. Both paths verified rendering and correct DOM order.
